description: QSBS Section 1202 Gain Exclusion — Qualified small business stock (IRC 1202) gain exclusion calculator, updated for the 2025 law change. Required: acquired (YYYY-MM-DD original issuance), sold (YYYY-MM-DD), gain (USD). Optional: basis (applies the 10x-basis cap), prior_excluded (gain already excluded for this issuer), filing (single|mfj|mfs), gross_assets (issuer gross assets at issuance). Stock issued after July 4 2025: 50/75/100% after 3/4/5 years, $15M cap, $75M assets test; earlier stock: 5-year hold, 50/75/100% by acquisition date, $10M cap. Returns excluded and taxable gain (28% section 1202 portion vs regular), AMT preference, next tier date, verdict FULLY_EXCLUDED/PARTIALLY_EXCLUDED/NOT_YET_ELIGIBLE/NOT_ELIGIBLE and the eligibility checklist. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
